resources.string: Turn textbooks and ebooks into razor-sharp notes in seconds - built for learners who skim but still want mastery.
There is one download to get started, so Wi-Fi is best. After that snapaie works with no signal at all, and nothing you read ever leaves your phone.
Reading, writing, history and narration all happen on this device. No account, no cloud, no data cost. It works in airplane mode.
A 500-page book, retold in 150. Works offline, nothing ever leaves your phone.

Turn any book into a shorter book you can actually finish, without losing the story.

Bring in a PDF or ebook, pick how short you want it, and snapaie retells it: the same story, in the same order, in the voice of the original, just shorter. Pictures come with it and the contents page is rebuilt to match. A 500-page novel can come back as 150 pages, or 50.

You can also photograph a real book page by page and turn the stack into a PDF.

- Works completely offline after one download
- No internet needed, so no data charges, ever
- Nothing leaves your device: no account, no login, no cloud
- Read it as it is written, chapter by chapter
- Export as a PDF, an ebook, or notes, and share anywhere
- Snap any page for a quick explanation, plus practice, chat and writing tools
- One-time Pro unlock. No subscription. No ads.
snapaie Pro is a one-time purchase handled by Google Play. There are no ads and no subscriptions.
